# get_rag_from_regions_and_grid { #mofography.compute.get_rag_from_regions_and_grid }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> skimage mean-color RAG builder; main flow builds RAGs from connections instead. Use `rag_from_connections` instead.

```python
compute.get_rag_from_regions_and_grid(regions, dgrid, ase_atoms, maxima=None)
```

Build a skimage mean-color RAG from regions with centroid and optional maxima node properties.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                         | Default    |
|-----------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| regions   |        | the regions that we computed from the distance grid | _required_ |
| dgrid     |        | the distance grid                                   | _required_ |
| ase_atoms |        | the atoms object from ase                           | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description              |
|--------|--------|--------------------------|
|        |        | A region adjacency graph |
